scenes.heading: HTL Fundamentals
scenes.narration: Components. HTL Fundamentals. In this video we review 8 key concepts you need to know for the certification.

scenes.question: What is HTL in AEM?
scenes.heading: The server-side template language for AEM that replaces JSP
scenes.body: The HTL fundamentals section says HTL, the HTML Template Language, is the server-side template language for AEM and that it replaces JSP.

scenes.question: How does the speech describe the design goal of HTL regarding security?
scenes.heading: It was designed to be secure and simple, with automatic context-aware XSS protection
scenes.body: The speech says HTL was designed to be secure and simple and that it automatically applies context-aware XSS protection.

scenes.question: What is the expression syntax used in HTL?
scenes.heading: A dollar sign and braces, like ${properties.jcr:title}
scenes.body: The speech states that HTL expressions use a dollar sign and braces, like ${properties.jcr:title}.

scenes.question: How are options added to an HTL expression?
scenes.heading: They follow an at sign, as in ${text @ context='html'}
scenes.body: The speech says HTL options follow an at sign, and the example given is ${text @ context='html'}.

scenes.question: What does the or operator do in an expression such as ${properties.pageTitle || properties.jcr:title || resource.name}?
scenes.heading: It can provide defaults by falling back through values
scenes.body: The HTL fundamentals section says the or operator can provide defaults, and gives a fallback example using pageTitle, jcr:title, and resource.name.

scenes.question: How do equality comparisons behave in HTL?
scenes.heading: They are strict, like triple equals in JavaScript, with no type conversion
scenes.body: The speech says comparison operators are strict and that the equality operators work like triple equals in JavaScript, with no type conversion.

scenes.question: Which global objects are named as available in HTL?
scenes.heading: properties, pageProperties, inheritedPageProperties, currentPage, resource, request, and wcmmode
scenes.body: The HTL fundamentals section explicitly names properties, pageProperties, inheritedPageProperties, currentPage, resource, request, and wcmmode as global objects available in HTL.

scenes.question: What must you do for script and style contexts in HTL?
scenes.heading: Set a context explicitly, otherwise nothing is output
scenes.body: The speech says that for script and style contexts you must set a context explicitly; otherwise nothing is output.
